research_question: How many patent cases reached federal district courts in 2025, how has PTAB institution changed, and how do the forums and periods differ?

research_brief.purpose: Owner-approved statistics page for patent litigation statistics, rebuilt from the owner draft after a live fact-check.
research_brief.audience: Readers, students, journalists, and legal professionals in the United States who need sourced figures.
research_brief.data_period: US Courts Judicial Business 2025 (fiscal years); Federal Judicial Caseload Statistics (year ending March 31, 2025); USPTO PTAB trial statistics October 2026 (FY23-FY27 YTD)
research_brief.scope_limitations: Court periods differ and are never combined. Trademark total of 4,211 in the owner draft was cut because it appears only in a summary, not the verbatim page text. PTAB institution is not invalidation.
